verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs explicitly state that Secure Cloud infrastructure partners meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications, operate in T3/T4 datacenters, and provide containerized multi-tenant isolation — directly addressing the platform engineer's compliance and datacenter-tier questions [runpod-docs-27][runpod-docs-28][runpod-docs-57]. However, Community Cloud (a cheaper peer-to-peer tier) is only 'vetted' without the same certifications, and there is no independent audit report, compliance certificate link, or detailed data-handling/data-residency documentation to corroborate the claims. Missing for 10: linked SOC 2 report or auditor attestation, explicit data handling/retention/encryption policy, and independent third-party verification of the compliance claims.
